paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM, over the course of training. The x-axis is labeled "Training Time (s)" and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000 seconds, with tick labels present at 50000 second intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and utilizes a linear scale, ranging from approximately 2.75 to 2.40. A purple solid line with a triangular marker represents the Vanilla model, starting at a loss of approximately 2.74 at 0 seconds, decreasing to a value of approximately 2.48 at 250000 seconds. A red solid line with a circular marker represents the SepLLM model, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.73 at 0 seconds, declining to approximately 2.47 at 250000 seconds.
